captions: Next, Dario's new dock scanner beeps, then nothing, and the free boat list is blank.
Scanning K1 out ends in an error, and so does the list of free boats.
You catch both crashes, fix the fleet and write the test, in three tasks.
Now K1 is checked out and the board lists the boats that are free.
Same scanner, same fleet. Dario can put the whiteboard away.
